'''''IG-1000''''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] variant starfighter piloted by the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88]].

==Description==
[[File:Ig1000stern.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The ''IG-1000'', firing its [[Laser cannon/Legends|lasers]]]]

The ''IG-1000'' was a modified TIE.<ref name="TDRA2" /> It was armed with two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] that fired red laser bolts. The ship's cockpit was square with open angular windows, unlike the cockpit windows on regular TIE-series fighters and transports. The solar panels carried the cannons, similar to the panels on the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. The ship had one thruster, which glowed with a yellow light, unlike the colorless exhaust on most TIE models.<ref name="TNK" />

==History==
The droid bounty hunter used the ''IG-1000'' in the year [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].<ref name="PH170">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> IG-88 flew the ship during his assignment from [[Ko Zatec-Cha]] to recover [[Mon Julpa]] and the [[Tammuz-an royal scepter]]. In order to capture Julpa and the scepter, IG-88 saved the lives of Julpa, his assistant [[Sollag Den]], [[Jessica Meade]], [[Jann Tosh]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. When their ship was attacked by [[Gir Kybo Ren-Cha]], the droid fired on Ren-Cha's attack ship, the [[Dianoga (starship)|''Dianoga'']], and routed the pirates.<ref name="TNK" />

==Behind the scenes==
On the [[TheForce.net]] thread devoted to ''The Droids Re-Animated'', author [[Abel G. Peña]] (nickname "Halagad_Ventor") implied that the original [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] model from which the ''IG-1000'' was modified had a connection to the [[Mark VI Supremacy-class starfighter|Sith interceptor]] of the earlier [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TFNAGP">{{WebCite|url=http://boards.theforce.net/threads/whats-this-more-droids-from-handley-and-peña.50012958/page-4|text=TFN discussion thread containing Abel G. Peña's answer about the unaltered TIE model.|archivedate=20240519210755}}</ref>
